title: Ranger Bill
identity_notes: Moody Bible Institute Christian family-adventure drama centered on forest ranger Bill Jefferson in Knotty Pine. Frozen GRH snapshot has 218 playable objects; 77 catalog rows lack dates, with one exact date recovered additively from RadioGOLDINdex. Some general references extend production to 1964, while specialist chronology ends its dated run in May 1962.

eras.label: Local WMBI 15-minute era
eras.notes: Early local era. Exact transition date is uncertain; April 14, 1954 is the earliest dated half-hour object in this GRH snapshot.

eras.label: Thirty-minute Moody syndication era
eras.notes: Thirty-minute national/syndicated phase; May 19, 1962 is a specialist last-dated endpoint, not asserted as an uncontested absolute series finale.

historical_context.title: Moody expansion of children's religious radio drama
historical_context.description: Official Moody history places Ranger Bill among its children's dramas launched in 1950 as part of its long-running broadcast ministry.

historical_context.title: Postwar family adventure, conservation and public-safety storytelling
historical_context.description: The surviving episode descriptions repeatedly use forest stewardship, rescue, wildlife, transportation safety and moral-choice plots.

historical_context.title: Mid-century religious-radio syndication
historical_context.description: Ranger Bill moved from local WMBI short-form broadcasting into a longer syndicated format reaching stations beyond Chicago.
